posts.title: Toone 1.0.79: Run Controls and Clearer Installs
posts.heading: Toone 1.0.79 lets you pause, edit and resume routines while they run
posts.description: Toone 1.0.79 adds pause, continue, cancel and edit controls for running routines, explains missing connectors in Explore installs, and fixes stale run states.

cover.alt: Toone 1.0.79 run panel with pause and edit controls

posts.body:
Toone 1.0.79 makes long routines easier to steer while they run and tidies up the Explore install flow. Here is what changed, and where each change applies.

## Run controls you can reach mid-run

You can now **pause**, **continue**, **cancel** or **edit** a routine while it is running, from the run panel or the Spotlight bar. Edits apply from the next step, and the run log records who intervened and when. The [routine run controls guide](/how-to/features/routines) walks through each action.

![The run panel with the new pause and edit controls](asset:jna_shot0release001)

## Explore installs that explain themselves

When a routine from [Explore](/explore) needs a connector you have not set up, Toone now names the missing piece and offers to set it up instead of failing the install.

| Change | Direct download | Mac App Store |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run controls | Yes | Yes |
| Explore install guidance | Yes | Yes |
| Browser helper diagnostics | Yes | Not applicable |

## Fixes

- Runs that were active when the app quit no longer show as running after relaunch.
- The Spotlight bar keeps its position across displays.
- Long agent names no longer clip in the organization chart.

## How the update reaches you

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[1.0.79 tagged] --> B[Direct download]
  A --> C[Mac App Store review]
```

Direct-download installs update in place from **Settings → Updates**. The Mac App Store build follows once review completes. Questions or regressions: write to [hello@trytoone.com](mailto:hello@trytoone.com).

posts.title: Automating Launch Content with AI Agents
posts.heading: How we turn a product brief into reviewed launch content
posts.description: A walkthrough of the Launch Kit bundle in Explore: how Toone agents prepare launch sites and drafts while a person approves everything that goes live.
posts.body:
Launch weeks produce the same pile of work every time: a directory list, a profile per site, a draft per channel, and a review pass before anything goes live. This spotlight shows how two Explore listings split that work between agents in Toone.

## Start with the bundle

The **Launch Kit** bundle groups the routines a launch needs, in the order you run them. Install it once and every routine arrives with its agents and requirements.

```explore
bundle: launch-kit-r5h8c2nd
```

## Prepare every launch site

The directory preparation routine researches each site's rules, prepares an authorized profile and writes an unpublished draft per site. It stops at CAPTCHAs, email verification and billing and hands back to you.

```explore
routine: product-launch-prep-directories-qk4m2x7a
variant: compact
```

## Keep a reviewer in the loop

Nothing is published by the routine itself. Each draft lands in your review queue with its sources, so you approve, edit or drop it. Read [how approvals work](/how-to/concepts) before your first run.

## A routine that is no longer listed

Listings can be withdrawn from Explore. When that happens the post keeps a plain link instead of a card:

```explore
routine: retired-launch-checklist-zz9zz9zz
```

Browse more routines like these in [Explore](/explore), or see [what is new in Toone](/journal/releases).

posts.title: Toone Pro Is Here: Unlimited Routine Creation
posts.heading: Toone Pro removes the routine creation limit
posts.description: Toone Pro is available today: unlimited routine creation and priority support, while running routines and installing from Explore stay free.
posts.body:
Toone Pro is available today for people who build more than a handful of routines. The free plan keeps everything it had; Pro removes the creation limit and adds priority support.

## What stays free

Running routines, installing from [Explore](/explore), and creating your first five routines stay free. Nothing you built on the free plan changes.

## What Pro adds

- Unlimited routine creation.
- Priority answers from the team at hello@trytoone.com.
- Early access to new Explore bundles.

## How to upgrade

Open **Settings → Account** in the app and choose a plan. Subscriptions are handled by Apple and can be managed from your Apple account at any time.

Read the [editorial policy](/editorial-policy) for how we write about pricing, and the [download page](/download) if you do not have Toone yet.
